title: Untouched Indian Lentils Dal
description: A traditional Indian lentil dish made with split red lentils, flavored with tadka and parsley, and served in a bamboo tray.
instructions: Rinse the lentils and soak them in water for 30 minutes.
In a large pot, combine the soaked lentils and 4 cups of water, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 20 minutes, or until the lentils are tender.
In a small pan, heat the ghee or oil over medium heat.
Add the cumin seeds and coriander seeds to the pan and let them sizzle for a few seconds.
Add the turmeric powder to the pan and stir for 1 minute.
Add the tadka mixture to the lentils and stir well.
Season the lentils with salt and stir in the chopped parsley.
Serve the dal in a bamboo tray.
Garnish with additional parsley if desired.
